changes.text: The required marker (`.req`) is spaced with `margin-inline-start` instead of `margin-left`, so the gap follows the writing direction under `dir="rtl"`.

Plain-HTML support: `dssoca/vanilla.css` styles the `.ss-textarea` markup, and `dssoca/vanilla.js` adds the autosize fallback for `.ss-textarea .field.autosize` in browsers without `field-sizing: content`.
The invalid focus ring is mixed from the `--ss-danger` slot with `color-mix()` instead of the removed `--ss-red-rgb` token, so it follows an imported palette.

New component: the multiline twin of `Input`, with the same `label` / `hint` / `error` anatomy and `--ss-input-*` field tokens, a bindable `value`, and an `autosize` option that grows with content between `rows` (default 3) and `maxRows` (default 10).
